storyCards.headline: Danny's Song: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Kenny Loggins's "Danny's Song" — original release 1972. "Danny's Song" is a song written by American singer-songwriter Kenny Loggins, as a gift for his brother Danny for the birth of his son, Colin.

It first appeared on an album by Gator Creek and a year later on the album Sittin' In, the debut album by Loggins and Messina.

The song is well remembered for both the Loggins and Messina original, as well as for Anne Murray's 1972 top-ten-charting cover.

This is the discography of Kenny Loggins.
